status: mixed: Emberwake Circlet implemented; other records remain proposals

items.name: Band of Continuance
items.effect: Ember Aura keeps its last paid pulse for 0.4s after movement cancels another action. It still pays upkeep; it cannot bypass insufficient mana.

items.name: Emberwake Circlet
items.effect: Ember Aura pulses every 0.4s instead of 0.5s; multiply per-pulse damage and cost by 0.8 so DPS and cost/s remain unchanged. Each paid pulse extends an existing burn by 0.15s, capped at 4s.

items.name: Riftglass Focus
items.effect: Arcane Fold leaves a memory focus for 3s. Starfall Script can target it once to repeat at 35% damage. Repeats cannot create repeats or return resources.

items.name: Crownless Vestment
items.effect: Crownless set, body piece. Cloth; Mage usable in the proposed full class system.

items.name: Crownless Sign
items.effect: Crownless set, amulet piece. No bonus until the required number of distinct set-piece IDs is worn.

items.name: Crownless Steps
items.effect: Crownless set, boots piece. Two pieces: recover 3 mana once per second when a paid aura pulse damages a cursed target. Three: first aura pulse after Arcane Fold has +25% radius for that pulse only.

stacking_rules: Only one copy of each named unique may be equipped.
Set count uses distinct set-piece IDs, not number of instances.
Triggered damage cannot retrigger the originating effect.
Recovery per second is capped per player and source.
Preserve independent branch choice: Cinder Bloom or Siphon Embers, never both.
